articles.title: Terrifying CCTV! Flying Tin Roof Crashes Into Devotees During Storm in Maharashtra, Three Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three devotees were injured, one of them critically, after a portion of a tin roof was ripped off by strong winds and crashed onto a road in Trimbakeshwar town of Maharashtra's Nashik district on Wednesday night.

body.html:
Three devotees were injured, one of them critically, after a portion of a tin roof was ripped off by strong winds and crashed onto a road in Trimbakeshwar town of Maharashtra's Nashik district on Wednesday night.

The incident occurred on the town's main road, where a group of eight devotees was walking through heavy rain. According to reports, strong gusts tore a section of the tin roof off a nearby house, sending it flying into the middle of the group.

The entire incident was captured on a CCTV camera installed outside a nearby house. The footage shows the devotees, dressed in raincoats, walking cautiously before the metal sheet suddenly hurtles towards them. While some managed to jump out of its path, others were knocked to the ground by the impact.

Those who escaped unhurt immediately rushed back to rescue the injured and shifted them to safety.

One of the injured, identified as Amit Subhash Adhe, a resident of Yavatmal, sustained critical injuries. He was initially taken to the Trimbakeshwar Sub-District Hospital on a two-wheeler before being referred to Nashik District Hospital for specialised treatment after receiving first aid.

The condition of the two other injured devotees was not immediately known.

The incident comes amid heavy rainfall and strong winds affecting parts of Nashik district.

#Maharashtra #Nashik #Trimbakeshwar #CCTV

articles.title: Terrifying CCTV Crash! WagonR, Hyundai Exter Collide Head-On in Kerala, Several Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A high-impact collision between a Maruti WagonR and a Hyundai Exter was reported near Cheruvalliyambalam in Ponkunnam, Kerala's Kottayam district, on Wednesday, leaving occupants of both vehicles injured.

body.html:
A high-impact collision between a Maruti WagonR and a Hyundai Exter was reported near Cheruvalliyambalam in Ponkunnam, Kerala's Kottayam district, on Wednesday, leaving occupants of both vehicles injured.

According to preliminary information and CCTV footage circulating online, the WagonR, travelling from the Manimala side, was attempting to turn right into a hotel parking area when it allegedly crossed the path of a Hyundai Exter travelling straight on the Punalur–Muvattupuzha Highway from the Ponkunnam side.

The two vehicles collided head-on, causing extensive front-end damage to both cars. The impact of the crash was captured on CCTV and has since gone viral on social media.

Local residents and staff from nearby establishments rushed to the spot and rescued the injured occupants before police arrived. The victims were shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment.

Ponkunnam Police have launched an investigation to determine the exact cause of the accident. Officials have not yet confirmed who was responsible for the crash, and further investigation is underway.

#Kerala #Kottayam #RoadAccident #CCTV #CarCrash

articles.title: Mumbai Cop’s Shocking Threat to Student Protesters Caught on Camera, Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video purportedly showing a Mumbai Police driver threatening detained student protesters with false drug cases has triggered widespread outrage, prompting the Mumbai Police to order an inquiry and remove the officer from his current posting.

body.html:
A video purportedly showing a Mumbai Police driver threatening detained student protesters with false drug cases has triggered widespread outrage, prompting the Mumbai Police to order an inquiry and remove the officer from his current posting.

The viral clip, allegedly recorded inside a police van following student protests over the exam paper leak issue, shows the police driver warning the detained students against participating in future demonstrations.

In the video, the officer is heard saying, "If I see you again at the protest, I'll plant 50 grams of powder in your pocket. Your life will be ruined. You won't get bail." He also remarks that the police were "suffering" because of the protests.

The students, seated at the back of the police vehicle, are seen smiling and laughing during the exchange.

Following the video's circulation on social media, Mumbai Police said an internal inquiry had been initiated. Deputy Commissioner of Police (Operations) Akbar Pathan confirmed that the officer had been removed from his current posting pending the outcome of the inquiry.

The video sparked sharp political reactions, with opposition parties alleging that the remarks amounted to intimidation of student protesters and an attack on democratic rights.

The controversy comes a day after large-scale student demonstrations in Mumbai over the exam paper leak issue, during which several protesters were detained.

Authorities have stated that appropriate action will be taken after the facts are verified.

#Mumbai #MumbaiPolice #ViralVideo #StudentProtest

articles.title: Road Rage Erupts in Gurugram! Car Driver, Biker Exchange Punches & Helmet Blows
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of road rage was reported from Gurugram after a car driver and a motorcyclist were caught on camera engaging in a violent street brawl following an alleged collision between their vehicles.

body.html:
A shocking case of road rage was reported from Gurugram after a car driver and a motorcyclist were caught on camera engaging in a violent street brawl following an alleged collision between their vehicles.

According to reports, the confrontation began after a minor collision between the car and the motorcycle. What started as a verbal argument quickly escalated into a physical fight, with both men exchanging punches, kicks and blows in the middle of a busy road.

The viral video shows the two men repeatedly assaulting each other as stunned bystanders watched the incident unfold. During the scuffle, one of them was also seen using a helmet to strike the other, further escalating the violence.

The altercation briefly disrupted traffic in the area before the situation was brought under control.

After the video surfaced on social media, Gurugram Police took cognisance of the incident and launched an investigation. Officials are examining the footage and other available evidence to establish the sequence of events, identify those involved and determine the circumstances that led to the alleged collision and subsequent assault.

Further details regarding any injuries or legal action are awaited.

#Gurugram #RoadRage #ViralVideo #Haryana

articles.title: Passengers' Lives at Risk? Bus Runs in Darkness Using Only a Torch, Viral Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A private bus carrying passengers was allegedly caught travelling at night without functioning headlights in Uttar Pradesh's Banda district, relying only on a torchlight to illuminate the road.

body.html:
A private bus carrying passengers was allegedly caught travelling at night without functioning headlights in Uttar Pradesh's Banda district, relying only on a torchlight to illuminate the road. A video of the bus, reportedly travelling from Banda to Baberu, has gone viral on social media, raising serious concerns over passenger safety.

The viral footage appears to show the driver operating the bus using only a handheld torch instead of headlights. According to local residents, the bus was carrying passengers, and several motorists and pedestrians narrowly avoided collisions due to the poor visibility.

Residents alleged that transport department officials were neglecting enforcement while allowing unsafe vehicles to operate. They also claimed that several private buses in the district were running without valid fitness certificates or permits, putting passengers at risk.

After the video surfaced online, Banda Superintendent of Police Palash Bansal's media cell directed the traffic police to investigate the incident. Authorities said strict legal action would be taken against the bus operator and driver if any violations are established.

The incident has triggered widespread criticism online, with many questioning road safety enforcement and the condition of private passenger buses in the district.

#UttarPradesh #Banda #RoadSafety #ViralVideo #BusSafety

articles.title: Daylight Robbery in Amritsar: ₹15 Lakh Snatched Seconds After Bank Withdrawal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman was robbed of ₹15 lakh in broad daylight after withdrawing the cash from a bank in Punjab's Amritsar on July 18. As she placed the cash on her scooter, two motorcycle-borne miscreants allegedly snatched her bag and fled.

body.html:
A woman was robbed of ₹15 lakh in broad daylight after withdrawing the cash from a bank in Punjab's Amritsar on July 18. As she placed the cash on her scooter, two motorcycle-borne miscreants allegedly snatched her bag and fled. Police rushed to the spot, examined nearby CCTV footage, and formed multiple teams to trace the accused. The investigation is underway. Authorities have urged people to exercise caution and avoid carrying large amounts of cash alone.

articles.title: Hyderabad Property Dispute Turns Violent: Woman Arrested for Allegedly Trying to Kill Mother-in-Law
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A long-running family property dispute in Hyderabad allegedly turned violent after a 33-year-old woman attempted to kill her 57-year-old mother-in-law by attacking her with a kitchen knife. The incident took place on the morning of July 21 at Erukala Basti in Chilakalguda, Secunderabad.

body.html:
A long-running family property dispute in Hyderabad allegedly turned violent after a 33-year-old woman attempted to kill her 57-year-old mother-in-law by attacking her with a kitchen knife.

The incident took place on the morning of July 21 at Erukala Basti in Chilakalguda, Secunderabad.

According to police, the accused, identified as D. Vijayalakshmi, allegedly attacked her mother-in-law, Devarai Padmavathi, while she was alone on the first floor of their house.

Police said Vijayalakshmi allegedly grabbed Padmavathi by the hair, dragged her inside the house and attacked her with a kitchen knife. The victim sustained serious injuries to her neck and fingers.

Hearing her screams, neighbours rushed to the house, intervened and rescued the injured woman. She was shifted to Gandhi Hospital, where she received emergency treatment. Police said her condition is stable.

Preliminary investigation revealed that the accused and the victim had been involved in a prolonged dispute over the ownership of the family house. Police believe the property dispute was the motive behind the attack.

Based on the victim's complaint, Chilakalguda Police registered a case under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Investigators inspected the crime scene, recorded witness statements, collected forensic evidence and seized the knife allegedly used in the attack.

Police arrested Vijayalakshmi on July 22. During interrogation, she allegedly confessed to the crime. The clothes she was allegedly wearing during the incident were also seized before she was produced before a court, which remanded her to judicial custody.

Hyderabad City Police urged the public to resolve family and property disputes through legal means and dialogue, warning that violence would invite strict legal action.

#Hyderabad #Telangana #CrimeNews #PropertyDispute

articles.title: Fake PhonePe Scam: Man Allegedly Dupes Jewellery Shop of ₹97,000 Gold Ornament in Telangana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man allegedly cheated a jewellery shop owner by using a fake PhonePe payment application to purchase a gold ornament worth ₹97,000 in Telangana's Bhadradri Kothagudem district. According to reports, the incident took place on Tuesday in Julurpad.

body.html:
A man allegedly cheated a jewellery shop owner by using a fake PhonePe payment application to purchase a gold ornament worth ₹97,000 in Telangana's Bhadradri Kothagudem district.

According to reports, the incident took place on Tuesday in Julurpad. The accused, identified as Rajesh, visited the jewellery shop and selected a gold ornament worth ₹97,000.

He then showed the shop owner what appeared to be a successful payment made through a PhonePe application. Believing the transaction had been completed, the shop owner handed over the ornament.

The accused subsequently left the shop on a two-wheeler. However, when the shop owner later checked the bank account, the payment had not been credited, revealing that the payment confirmation shown on the mobile phone was allegedly fake.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the shop.

A complaint has been lodged with the police, who have launched an investigation and are trying to trace the accused.

#Telangana #BhadradriKothagudem #Julurpad #PhonePe

articles.title: Karnataka Woman's Death: In-Laws Booked for Alleged Murder After Mother's Complaint
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case has been registered at the Sullia Police Station against the in-laws of a woman who allegedly died following prolonged domestic harassment and family disputes in Karnataka. The deceased has been identified as Fathimath Nishana, who had been married for four years.

body.html:
A case has been registered at the Sullia Police Station against the in-laws of a woman who allegedly died following prolonged domestic harassment and family disputes in Karnataka.

The deceased has been identified as Fathimath Nishana, who had been married for four years. The complaint was filed by her mother, Zubaida (43), a resident of Kedambadi in Puttur.

The accused have been identified as Fathimath's father-in-law Alavi, mother-in-law Ayisha and sister-in-law Faseela.

According to the complaint, on the night of July 18, Fathimath called her mother and allegedly revealed that she was being subjected to severe physical and mental harassment by her in-laws. During the phone conversation, her father-in-law, Alavi, allegedly snatched the phone and threatened to kill her.

Zubaida immediately rushed to her daughter's house but, according to the complaint, received the news that Fathimath had died before she could reach.

Alleging that her daughter was murdered over ongoing family disputes, Zubaida lodged a complaint against the three accused.

Based on the complaint, Sullia Police registered a case under Crime No. 100/2026 and relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including Sections 85 and 103(1) read with Section 3(5).

Police said further investigation is underway.

#Karnataka #Sullia #CrimeNews #DomesticViolence

articles.excerpt: A 30-year-old man was killed and a woman sustained a fractured leg after a car allegedly veered onto a footpath in Karnataka's Chitradurga district. The incident, captured on CCTV, is under police investigation. According to reports, the accident took place near T.

body.html:
A 30-year-old man was killed and a woman sustained a fractured leg after a car allegedly veered onto a footpath in Karnataka's Chitradurga district. The incident, captured on CCTV, is under police investigation.

According to reports, the accident took place near T. Nulenur in Holalkere taluk when the driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle. The car mounted the footpath and ran over people standing there.

The deceased has been identified as Pradeep (30), a resident of Dagge village in Holalkere taluk.

The injured woman was rushed to a hospital, where she is undergoing treatment for a fractured leg.

CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, showing the car crashing onto the footpath before striking the victims.

Police have registered a case at Chitrahalli Police Station and launched an investigation to ascertain the exact cause of the accident.

#Karnataka #Chitradurga #RoadAccident #CCTV
